items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 18 August 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Locally strong wind at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the mid-Atlantic, various fronts affecting Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

West 4 or 5 occasionally 6 at first.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate.


##Weather##

Showers, possibly merging into longer spells of rain later. Becoming mainly fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, soon backing southwest for a time, gradually veering northerly 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate until later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then scattered showers soon developing.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.
